lines.text: False teachers will secretly bring in destructive heresies, deny the Master who bought them, and exploit believers in their greed.
God did not spare the angels who sinned, and He preserved Abraham among the eight when the flood came.
God rescued righteous Lot, who was tormented by lawless deeds, because the Lord knows how to rescue the godly.
The false teachers follow the way of Balaam son of Beor, who was rebuked for his transgression by a lion.
They promise freedom while being slaves to depravity, and those who turn back are like a dog returning to its vomit.
